label: High Atlas · Middle Atlas

resorts.label: Oukaïmeden

pass_multi.note: estimate: 0.85 x day pass x 6; Oukaimeden sells no multi-day pass, lifts are per-ride only

resorts.pass_note: no all-mountain day pass exists: lifts are sold per ride (~20 MAD/ride) or as separate access - main chairlift ~100 MAD/day, the six small drag lifts ~50 MAD/day combined; 150 MAD is a realistic estimate for a full ski day using both. No fixed holiday surcharge found
resorts.stay_src: estimate: very limited lodging at Oukaimeden itself (small inns/CAF refuge, roughly 200-400 MAD/night per room); many visitors day-trip from Marrakech (~1h15) instead; simple tagine lunch and dinner ~60-80 MAD each

resorts.label: Michlifen

pass_multi.note: estimate: 0.85 x day pass x 6; Michlifen sells no multi-day pass, season too short/ad-hoc for one

resorts.pass_note: day pass reported in the 100-150 MAD range depending on season/source; no official season price sheet found online, so a 120 MAD regular / 150 MAD holiday estimate is used; opening date (2027-01-05) is typical/illustrative only - the station runs entirely on snow-dependent, ad-hoc opening (only when snowpack exceeds ~50cm, typically 3-6 weeks/winter)
resorts.stay_src: estimate: budget/mid Ifrane-town hotels (Farah Inn ~37 EUR, Hotel Perce Neige ~40 EUR per room) roughly 200-350 MAD pp - excludes the separate 5-star Michlifen Resort & Golf (210+ EUR/night); simple Ifrane restaurant meals ~35-150 MAD per person per meal

tiers.pass: LOW < 45 EUR <= MID <= 65 EUR < HIGH (per ski day: advance multi-day pass rate when the trip has >= 3 ski days, else the adult day ticket, EUR)
tiers.hotel: LOW < 60 EUR <= MID <= 120 EUR < HIGH (per person per night sharing, estimate)
tiers.pistes: size + altitude: >=120 km = 2 pts, >=50 km = 1, top >=2900 m = +1; HIGH >=2, MID 1, LOW 0
tiers.snow: projected depth at the start date (P50): HIGH >=120 cm, MID >=60 cm, LOW below

explainer: Snow at the start date = snow now at the resort + 40 % of the ensemble members' snowfall (ECMWF and GFS ensembles to their horizon) + the change the past winters show from that horizon to the date. Likely range = 20th-80th percentile of the scenarios. Prices: lift pass at the advance multi-day pass rate for trips of 3 ski days or more (walk-up day tickets cost more, shown as pass_walkup); night and food are estimates.
notes: night_eur and food_day_eur are estimates per person (sharing a room / apartment)
pass = advance multi-day pass rate x ski days for 3+ ski days (cost.pass_basis), else walk-up day tickets; cost.pass_walkup = what day tickets would cost
budget_eur is the whole party's budget; left_eur compares it with party_total_eur
